$meta.procedure: Figma variables -> this file is synced by Claude via Figma MCP (see CLAUDE.md / ADR-0010). Then run `pnpm sync:tokens` to regenerate app/theme.css. Never edit app/theme.css by hand.

semantic.$comment: A plain string ref is a light-only token (no dark variant yet). An object { light, dark } carries a dark-mode override. `pnpm sync:tokens` emits the dark refs into a `[data-theme="dark"] { ... }` block in app/theme.css — that attribute is what Ladle's Light/Dark toggle sets on <html> (see @ladle/react's init-side-effects.ts); it's also the hook the real app would use once it grows its own theme switch (not built yet, out of scope for #42). Dark values below are this round's addition (2026-07-20, ticket #42), scoped to the primitives Atom/Button actually uses — no Figma dark-mode frames exist to fetch, so these are derived by staying inside Tailwind's stock stone/red scale rather than inventing one-off hex. Not every token has a dark counterpart yet; that's a flagged gap for a future token-sync pass, not an oversight. TICKET #52 (2026-07-20): Figma's semantic variables were reworked to carry a per-state variation (Default/Hover/Selected) for every colour role; the `*-hover`/`*-selected` tokens added below follow that same state tier. Their dark values are this ticket's own pick (no Figma dark frames exist), each reusing an existing stock stone/red shade already established by #42 rather than inventing a new primitive — flagged per-token below. `surface-hover` (stone-300) loses its only consumer (`Atom/Button`'s Filled hover moved to `surface-raised-hover`, stone-400, per the re-fetched node) — NOT deleted, kept for the user to decide since it may still be wanted for a future non-Button hover. Also: the Figma MCP server returns resolved hex only, never variable names, so every semantic token name below (this ticket and earlier ones) is derived from matching pixel values back to a role, not read from Figma's own variable names — they may need aligning with the real Figma variable names later.

typography.$comment: Figma text styles are Tailwind-native; no CSS generation needed. This is the authoritative mapping for agents (font: Inter).
